title: Establish cost operating rhythm & initiative tracker for batching/caching/quantization
creator: Noah Park
description: Set up a repeatable operating rhythm and a single initiative tracker that ties experiments (batching, KV prefix cache, quantization trials) to measurable OKRs. Deliverables: (1) tracker template with experiment metadata and success criteria, (2) weekly cadence for hypothesis triage and rollups, (3) integration to Observatory cost dashboards and Console rollouts, (4) handoff doc for Dedicated/Private adoption. This ticket owns defining the taxonomy, templates, and initial 6-week pilot of 10 experiments across engineering and field teams.
acceptance_criteria: Tracker template includes fields for hypothesis, expected saving %, SLO tolerance, rollout plan, rollback criteria
Integration with Console observability: each experiment shows token-cost delta & latency delta in dashboard (linkable)
Weekly 30-min triage cadence scheduled and calendar invites sent to stakeholders
Pilot executed on 10 experiments with documented outcomes and at least 3 validated savings paths
Handoff docs and runbook published to Confluence and linked from tracker
metrics_targets: Reduce token cost per 1M by >= 8% across pilot cohort
No more than 5% increase in median latency for production-simulated load
At least 3 experiments show >10% unit-cost improvement without quality regression

notes: This initiative should remain model-agnostic: all experiments must declare compatible model families. Early pilot focuses on chat and completion workloads. Emphasize safety: any experiment that degrades quality beyond 1% must be paused and reviewed. Plan to formalize into a recurring initiative if pilot meets targets.
